company.name: ARA
company.shortDescription: ARA provides License Plate Recognition (LPR) software and related advanced camera solutions.
company.description:
ARA provides License Plate Recognition (LPR) software and related advanced camera solutions. ARH develops, manufactures and distributes intelligent software and devices which process images in the context of security, safety and traffic control. A majority of their clients are system integrator companies who fabricate innovative technological systems for their customers. Their technology and products aid their partners bringing to the market the latest high-tech, most accurate and reliable recognition solutions. 

Having been on the market for over 20 years, they continue their committment to innovation, quality, reliability, and credibility. Their recognition technologies can be found in every continent and in countries ranging from Australia to Brazil, Saudi Arabia to Korea and beyond. Committed to providing uncompromised quality in all of its products and services at all times, ARH is certified according to three ISO standards. 

It is their priority to understand and meet the exact needs of their customers. They aim to bring you complete satisfaction with their products, services and support by combining their deeper understanding with their knowledge, expertise and state-of-the-art technology. By understanding your needs and requirements they provide you the right leading edge technology with mindful services and support.
